{{O|details=Images may be mildly terrifying for some audiences|severity=Low - Moderate}} {{Non-Mainstream|reason = Wikimade brainrot because it doesn't have a video.}} {{Wikimade}}'''Slop God''' is a wiki-made brainrot that is believed to be the creator of [[Italian Brainrot]] (Except [https://italianbrainrot.miraheze.org/wiki/Category:Tier_0 Tier 0] ones). He was created by the registered user [[User:Krokscer|Krokscer]].[[File:Download....jpg|thumb|The one true creator of Italian Brainrot.]]
== Lyrics == '''<big>Original (Italian)</big>'''
''Il Dio delle Slop, il creatore del Brainrot. Vuole distruggere Internet e causare cose brutte. Tutte le creature italiane del Brainrot sono sue amiche.''
'''<big>Lyrics (English)</big>'''
''The God of Slop, the creator of Brainrot. He wants to destroy the Internet and cause bad things. All the Italian Brainrot creatures are his friends.''
== Lore == The Slop God is the true antagonist of the Italian Brainrot universe. He is a partner in crime with [[SPOOKY SPOOKY AHH]] He started the Brainrot Epidemic on July 7th, 2023. He is responsible for turning [[Italian Brainrot]] into [[Elsagate]] memes or Overused memes. [[Mecratto Vortole]] were neutral or have diplomatic relationship with him, but the [[King of Neutral]] was completely against his agenda, and "planned" to take him down.
On the 5th of September 2025, he was awakened to challenge both [[Wallotelo Tralala]] and [[King of Neutral]] during the [[Megaptera War]].
If the Slop God ever fused with [[Kinginni Cobraninni Dragonfruitinni]] and the [[True God of Chaos]], it would be Armageddon for all.
He was defeated during the Battle of the End on October 17th, 2025. He died, but [[Kinginni Cobraninni Dragonfruitinni]] is still alive, and absorbed ALL of his powers.
[[File:Slopking.jpg|thumb|The Slop King is his ultimate transformation.]]
== List of Brainrots the Slop God created in Fanon Universe == * AI-generated kids' videos (Along with all sorts of AI Slop) * Alpha/Sigma memes * Brainrot [[Wikipedia: Slang|Slang]] * [[Wikipedia: Content farms|Content farms]] * [[Wikipedia: Elsagate|Elsagate]] * [[Wikipedia: Emoji|Emoji]] cat slop (no, not the good emoji cats, the bad ones.) * [[Italian Brainrot]] (In collaboration with [[Mecratto Vortole]]) * [[Wikipedia:Labubu|Labubu]]s (only the slop made of labubus) * The [[Wikipedia: LeBron James|LeBron James]] sunshine meme * Mewing * [[Wikipedia: Mobile advertising|Mobile advertising]] (only the slop ones) * [[Wikipedia: Ohio|Ohio]] memes * All other brainrot
== Trivia == * This brainrot is enemies with the population of [[Dagolia]] and [[Purrito]]. But he has already eliminated the whole planet.
* This Brainrot got defeated by nukes but that isn't canon [[Category:Tier 0]]
